name: Offended Epitaphs
description: Funerary inscriptions flicker and display different messages, causing ghostly ancestors to briefly appear and complain that their descendants have forgotten them.
disable: three DC 20 Diplomacy check, DC 20 Occultism check, or DC 20 Religion checks to rebuke the cantankerous spirits
routine: (2 actions) Ancestral spirits appear throughout areas D1 and D2, each fading after several rounds to be replaced by a different spirit.

defensiveAbilities.name: Growing Grumbles
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of area D2

Effect The haunt rolls initiative as the ancestral spirits begin manifesting.

offensiveAbilities.name: Lambast
offensiveAbilities.description:
A spirit yells at a living creature, which must attempt a DC 18 Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes 2 persistent plus mental damage. Until the persistent damage ends, the creature can perceive ghostly Dwarven inscriptions floating several inches in front of the various inscriptions throughout the park.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature takes 4 persistent plus mental damage and is Stupefied 1 until the persistent damage ends.
